dependency-candidate.scope: All remaining inputs match byte-for-byte. A scalar-file difference is admitted only for the reviewed removal of incidental formatting with identical canonical rustfmt output. BREP test-module wiring can differ only for dependency commands that do not consume those files; BREP consumers are requalified after their module repair. Original snapshots and every failed attempt remain retained.
